apply_page.statutory_annual_info: BCEA §20: maḓuvha a mushumo a {minDays} a vhukhoni ha ṅwaha kha tshirendo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. {accrual}
apply_page.statutory_sick_info: BCEA §23: Vhukhoni ha u lwala hu lavhelesiwa kha tshirendo tsha miṅwaha mararu (maḓuvha a 36 kha vhege ya maḓuvha a 5). Tshiṱaṱisi tsha u dokotela tshi a ṱoḓea nga murahu ha maḓuvha mavhili o teraho, nga Musumbuluwo/Ḽavhuṱanu, kana musi tshivhalo tsha vhege ya 8 tshi tshi fhira maḓuvha a 6.
apply_page.statutory_frl_info: BCEA §27: maḓuvha a {cap} a Vhukhoni ha Vhuḓifhinduleli ha Muṱa kha tshirendo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha vhukhoni ha ṅwaha. Zwiitea zwine zwa ṱoḓea: u bebwa ha ṅwana, u lwala ha ṅwana, lufu lwa muraḓo wa muṱa wa tsini.
apply_page.statutory_maternity_info: BCEA §25: miṅwedzi mina yo teraho ya vhukhoni ha u bebwa hu si na mbadelo. Pulei ya vhukhoni ha vhabebi yo tendelwaho i fanela u ṅwaliswa na HR nga phanḓa ha u humbela.
apply_page.statutory_parental_info: Van Wyk 2025 / BCEA §25A: Vhukhoni ha vhabebi hu ṱoḓa pulei yo tendelwaho yo ṅwaliswaho na HR. Awara dzo ṋekedzwaho dzi dzhielwa kha pulei; milayo ya vhukhoni ha tshifhinga tshifhaṱaho i a shuma.
apply_page.statutory_study_info: Vhukhoni ha pfunzo hu ḓi disaho kha tendelo ya vhulanguli na maṅwalo a u tikedza (tshiṱaṱisi tsha u ṅwaliswa / ntanguludzo ya milingo).
apply_page.statutory_unpaid_info: Vhukhoni hu si na mbadelo a hu nga badelwa. Tendelo i kha muhasho wa muḓinḓa waṋu na HR.

authority.title: Vhukoni ha Nethiweke
authority.subtitle: Nethiweke yo dzudzanywaho nga phara ine mabindu a tea a redzelana nga mvelele
authority.explainer: Dzhenani nahone AI i ni tanganedza na mabindu o teaho, a sa khominisani na inwi, u itela uri zwibveledzwa zwanu zwi wane linki dza mvelele, dza vhurangaphanda — nahone ni linka murahu hune zwa thusa vhavhali vhanu nga vhukuma. Ni dzula ni na vhulangi hoṱhe ha uri ndi nnyi ane a ni linka na uri nga vhungana.
authority.no_websites: Engedzani website u thoma u itela u dzhena kha nethiweke.
authority.join_body: Aluwisani vhukoni hanu nga linki dza vhurangaphanda dzo teaho na maṅwe mabindu a fulufhedzeaho. Ni langa mugaganyagwama wanu wa linki, masiaṱari a ndeme na mifuda ine na fanela u i iledza. Dzhenani, imisani kana ṱutshelani tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
authority.leave_confirm: Ni ṱutshela Nethiweke ya Vhukoni? Linki dzanu dzi nga si tsha vhewa kana u ṱanganedzwa.
authority.competitors_hint: Awa mabindu a nga si vhuya a linkiwa na inwi
authority.blacklist_hint: Indasitiri dzine na sa fune u linka nadzo
authority.no_pages: A hu athu vha na masiaṱari a ndeme. Engedzani masiaṱari ane na toda linki khao nga maanda.
authority.no_matches: A hu athu vha na vho teaho — fhedzisani phurofaela yanu nahone vhuyani hafhu musi mabindu manzhi a tshi dzhena.
authority.paused_note: Bvelani phanda na vhurado hanu u itela u vhona vhathihisani vho tewaho.
authority.no_links: A hu na zwikwamo zwo vhewaho. Zwikwamo zwi engedzwa nga u ita hu si na u vhudziwa musi ni tshi ita content.
authority.credits_note: Dzi-backlink dzi tshi shuma dzo delivarwaho u tou vhambedza na mbetshelo yau ya nwedzi. Dzilinki dzi lindelwaho dzi kha di vha dzi tshi khou vhewa kha netiweke.

guides.facebook:
1. Yani kha akhaunthu yaṋu ya Meta Business / Developers.
2. Sikani Page Access Token i na thendelo ya pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopani Page ID yaṋu (kha About/Settings ya Page) na thoukhini nga fhasi.
guides.x:
1. Yani kha developer.x.com ni vule epulikheishini yaṋu.
2. Bveledzani OAuth 2.0 user access token i na tweet.write scope.
3. Nambatedzani thoukhini nga fhasi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Yani kha linkedin.com/developers ni vule epulikheishini yaṋu.
2. Wanani access token i na w_member_social scope.
3. Nambatedzani author URN yaṋu (urn:li:person:XXXX) na thoukhini nga fhasi.
guides.instagram:
1. Instagram yaṋu i tea u vha akhaunthu ya Business yo ṱanganaho na Facebook Page.
2. Wanani thoukhini i na thendelo ya instagram_content_publish.
3. Nambatedzani Instagram user ID yaṋu na thoukhini nga fhasi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Dzudzanyani WhatsApp Cloud API kha Meta.
2. Kopani access token yaṋu ya tshoṱhe.
3. Nambatedzani nomboro ya luṱingo ya muṱanganedzi (na khoudi ya shango) na thoukhini nga fhasi.

ext_hint.instagram: Instagram Business account user ID yaṋu
ext_hint.whatsapp: Nomboro ya luṱingo ya muṱanganedzi na khoudi ya shango, e.g. 27821234567

skills_levy.what_this_is: Muholo u badela muthelo wa u bveledzisa vhutsila ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe na EMP201. Tshipiḓa tshithihi kha zwiṱanu tshawo tshi nga humiselwa sa thuso i kombetshedzeaho, fhedzi nga muṋetshedzamushumo ane a rumela Mbekanyamushumo ya Vhutsila ha Fhethu ha Mushumo hu si athu swika ḽa 30 Lambamai.
skills_levy.exempt: Fhasi ha tshikalo tsha R500 000 — wo vhofhololwa
skills_levy.all_good: A hu na tshithu tshi salaho kha ṅwaha uyu wa muthelo.
skills_levy.record_help: Ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza ḽa ṅwaha uyu wa muthelo ndi {deadline}. Zwe ni zwi humbela zwi vhalwa u bva kha muthelo wo badelwaho zwa vhukuma, a zwi ṅwaliwi nga tshanḓa.

councils.description: Mithelo ya khoro, tshikalo tshine i vhalwa ngatsho, na uri i vhueledza vhashumi vhafhio.
councils.how_it_works: Muthelo u bviswa kha muholo muṅwe na muṅwe wa vhashumi vhane khoro i vha vhueledza, nahone u badelwa na mbuelo ya muṋetshedzamushumo. Vhurathu ndi nga muthu nga muthihi: muṋetshedzamushumo muthihi kanzhi u na vhashumi vho vhueledzwaho na vha songo vhueledzwaho kha muholo muthihi.
councils.beneficiary_hint: Tshikwama tshi re kha tshikirini tsha mbadelo dza vhaṅwe tshine tshi wana muthelo uyu.
councils.no_beneficiary: A hu na tshikwama tsho tanganyiswaho, ngauralo muthelo u bviswa fhedzi a hu na tshithu tshine tsha dzudzanya u u badela.
councils.no_rate: A hu na tshikalo tsho ṅwalwaho — a hu na tshithu tshine tsha ḓo bviswa.
councils.fixed_line: {employee} kha mushumi, {employer} kha muṋetshedzamushumo, tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
councils.percent_line: {employee}% kha mushumi na {employer}% kha muṋetshedzamushumo, zwo pimiwa kha {ceiling}.
councils.nobody_covered: A hu na muthu o vhueledzwaho nga khoro iyi zwino.
councils.rate_help: Tsheo ine i shuma i valwa ḓuvha ḽa phanḓa ha musi iyi i tshi thoma, ngauralo a hu na ḓuvha ḽo vhueledzwaho luvhili.
councils.ceiling_hint: Dzikhoro dzi vhea tshipimo kha mithelo ya phesenthe. Nga nnḓa hatsho ane a hola nnyanya u bviselwa nga nṱha ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe.
councils.source_hint: Hune tshivhalo tshi bva, tsumbo ṅwambo wa gazethe wa khoro
councils.members_help: Fhedzi vhashumi vhane khoro iyi i vha vhueledza. U engedza vhoṱhe hu khakhea samusi u sa engedza muthu.
councils.none_yet: A hu na dzikhoro dzo vhewaho.

report_sources.projects: U bva kha dziphurojeke dzone — Dziphurojeke, ni kone u vula nthihi.
report_sources.work: U bva kha siaṱari ḽa Mushumo ḽa phurojeke iṅwe na iṅwe, hune vhuvhumbeo na mishumo yaho zwa fhaṱwa hone.
report_sources.dependencies: U bva kha Mushumo → Ṱanganyani mishumo, hune mushumo muthihi wa itwa uri u lindele muṅwe.
report_sources.schedule: Zwi vhalwa nga mudzudzanyi u bva kha vhulapfu ha mishumo na vhukwamani hayo. Zwi shumiseni kha siaṱari ḽa Mbekanya ḽa phurojeke.
report_sources.baseline: Zwi vhambedza ṋamusi na mutalo wa mutheo wo vhulungwaho. Vhulungani muṅwe kha siaṱari ḽa Mbekanya ḽa phurojeke.
report_sources.recurrence: U bva kha mulayo wa u dovholola nga ngomu ha mushumo, kha siaṱari ḽa Mushumo.
report_sources.evidence: U bva kha rejisiṱara ya vhuṱanzi — tshishumiswa tsha masimuni, vharumeli vha modulu na API ya u dzhenisa.
report_sources.figures: Zwi bva kha vhuṱanzi. Sedzani siaṱari ḽa Zwivhalo ḽa phurojeke uri ni wane milayo i re nga murahu ha tshivhalo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
report_sources.timesheets: U bva kha U Ṋetshedza → Tshifhinga kha phurojeke. Engedzani vhathu u thoma kha thebe ya Vhathu — awara dzi ṅwalwa nga muraḓo.
report_sources.assignments: U bva kha Mushumo, nga u ṋea muraḓo mushumo, nga phesenthe ya u kovhelwa. Engedzani vhathu u thoma kha U Ṋetshedza → Vhathu.
report_sources.labour: Awara dzo tendelwaho × tshikalo. Vhewani tshikalo musi ni tshi ṅwala awara kha U Ṋetshedza → Tshifhinga; hu vhalwa awara dzo tendelwaho fhedzi.
report_sources.costs: U bva kha U Ṋetshedza → Mbadelo kha phurojeke, hune zwishumiswa, mitshini na vhakondiraka vha fhasi zwa ṅwalwa hone. Hu vhalwa zwo tendelwaho na zwo badelwaho fhedzi.
report_sources.members: U bva kha U Ṋetshedza → Vhathu kha phurojeke.
report_sources.approvals: Zwi sikwa nga u ḓiita musi awara kana mbadelo zwi tshi rumelwa. Uri ndi nnyi ane a ita tsheo zwi vhewa kha Setup → Nḓila ya u tendela.
report_sources.links: U bva kha siaṱari ḽa phurojeke, nga u tshimbidza rekhodo ya iṅwe modulu — thundu, odara ya u renga, kondiraka.
report_sources.registers: Zwo ṅwaliwa kha mutevhe wa projeke wa khombo, thaidzo na tshanduko

site.diary_sub: Ḽiṅwalo ḽine khumbelo ya u lenga ya haniswa ngaḽo — a ḽi thusi arali ḽi songo ṅwaliwa nga ḽeneḽo ḓuvha
site.no_diary: A hu na miṅwalo ya bugu zwino.
site.no_diary_hint: Bugu ya fhethu ha mushumo ndi ḽiṅwalo ḽa u thoma ḽine muthu a ḽi ṱoḓa musi hu tshi haniswa nga u lenga.
site.delays_hint: Tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsho imisaho kana tsha lengisa mushumo. Ndi vhuṱanzi ha u engedzwa ha tshifhinga.
site.snags_sub: Zwithu zwa mutevhe wa u lugisa, u sa fhelela na u sa tevhedza milayo
site.no_snags: A hu na tshine tsha sala.
site.close_needs_evidence: U sa tevhedza milayo kana vhukhakhi vhuhulu zwi fanela u amba uri zwo lugiswa hani — mutevhe wo ḓalaho nga u valwa hu si na tshithu a u nga imelwi musi mushumo u tshi fhiriselwa.
site.kind_hint: Vhukhakhi ndi ha kuvhonele; NCR ndi u kundelwa ha ndeme ho dzudzanywaho hune ha fanela u valwa nga vhuṱanzi.
site.boq_sub: Mutengo we mushumo wa vhewa khawo, na zwe zwa kalwa u lwa nawo
site.no_boq: A hu na zwithu zwa mutevhe zwino.
site.measure_hint: Zwo ṱanganyiswaho, hu si zwa ino tshifhinga. Mutevhe ndi wa {quantity} {unit}.
site.item_no_hint: Tsumbo kha mutevhe u re na mitengo, tsm. 1.2.3
site.provisional_note: I nga kha ḓi si shumiswe
site.claims_sub: Mushumo wo kalwaho u swika zwino, ho bviswa tshelede yo vhulungwaho, ho bviswa zwe zwa no khwaṱhisedzwa
site.draft_claim_sub: Tshivhalo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi vhalwa u bva kha mutevhe na kha tshiṱifikeiṱi tsha u fhedza — shandukisa fhedzi zwine na fanela u zwi shandukisa.
site.no_claims_hint: Kalani mutevhe u thoma; khumbelo i lugiselwa u bva khawo.
site.confirm_certify_body: Khumbelo #{number} ya {amount} i vha tshelede i kolodzwaho, nahone i ṅwaliwa kha mitengo ya mushumo. Hezwi a zwi nga vhuyeledzwi.
site.work_to_date: Mushumo wo kalwaho u swika zwino
site.work_to_date_hint: I dzhia ndeme yo kalwaho ya mutevhe nga iyone.
site.retention_hint: Kanzhi ndi 10%, i fhungudzea ya vha hafu musi mushumo wo fhela nga u shuma.
site.milestone_claim_hint: Fhedzi kha zwiṱhavhelo zwine zwa badela nga miḽiga u fhira u badela nga tshikalo.
site.retention_note: I vhofhololwa musi mushumo wo fhela nga u shuma na nga u fhedza

resources.title: Dzikamara, dzilaisense na midzhini
resources.subtitle: Zwithu zwine mushumo wa zwi bukha zwine ha vha na muṅwe modulu u re na mutevhe wazwo. Thundu na goloi zwi sala kha modulu dzazwo nahone zwi kwamanywa u bva kha mushumo.
resources.confirm_remove_named: {name} a tshi tsha ḓo ṋekedzwa. Miṱhannga i no tshi shumisa i vhulunga rekhodo yayo.
resources.none: A hu na tshithu hafhu zwino.
resources.name: Dzina
resources.identifier_hint: Nomboro ya kamara, kana tsumbo ya laisense.
resources.capacity_hint: Zwidulo, kana dzilaisense dzi shumiswaho nga tshifhinga tshithihi.
resources.available_to_hint: Kha laisense, ḽeneḽi ndi ḓuvha ḽa u fhela.
resources.is_active: I a wanala uri i bukhiwe

purchases.note: Hezwi zwi ita khumbelo ya u renga kha Muhasho wa u Renga, i re na khoudu ya ino mushumo. Ṱhoḓisiso dzavho dza mbadelo na nḓila ya thendelo zwi a shuma — a hu na tshine tsha odariwa hu si athu ṱanganedzwa.
purchases.justification_hint: Ndi ngani mushumo u tshi ṱoḓa. Ndi zwine a ṱanganedzaho a zwi vhala u thoma.
purchases.unavailable: U renga hu humbelwa kha modulu wa u Renga, u songo dzheniswaho kha ino fhethu ha mushumo.

announcements.title: Nḓivhadzo
announcements.subtitle: U vhudza tshigwada tshoṱhe tsha mushumo tshithu, na rekhodo ya uri ndi nnyi o tshi vhonaho.
announcements.audience_hint: Mushumo muthihi, kana vhoṱhe vha itaho mushumo wa miṱhannga.
announcements.body: Zwine na ṱoḓa vha tshi zwi ḓivha
announcements.urgent_warning: Nḓivhadzo dzi ṱoḓaho u ṱavhanya dzi dovha dza rumelwa nga SMS kha vhoṱhe vha re kha mushumo, nahone dzi vhalwa kha mbadelo yaṋu ya SMS ya ṅwedzi.
announcements.expires_at: Litshani u i sumbedza nga murahu ha
announcements.expires_hint: I sieni i si na tshithu uri i dzule i hone u swika ni tshi i bvisa.
announcements.require_ack: Humbelani vhathu uri vha i khwaṱhisedze
announcements.require_ack_hint: Shumisani hezwi kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi re na masiandaitwa a tsireledzo kana a thendelano — hu si kha nḓivhadzo dzo ḓoweleaho.
announcements.ack_pending_body: Hu na muthu a ṱoḓaho u ḓivha uri no dzi vhala.
announcements.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” i a bviswa. Rekhodo ya vhe vha i vhona i a vhulungwa.
announcements.mail_ack_required: Ri humbela ni vule nḓivhadzo ni khwaṱhisedze uri no i vhala.

registers.title: Khombo, thaidzo na tshanduko
registers.subtitle: Zwine zwa nga tshimbila luvhi, zwe zwa no tshimbila luvhi, na zwine zwa humbelwa uri zwi shandukiswe.
registers.risks_sub: Zwine zwa sa athu itea — na zwine ra funa u ita ngazwo
registers.issues_sub: Zwe zwa itea, na nḓila ye zwa lugiswa ngayo
registers.changes_sub: Khumbelo dza u shandukisa mutheo, na masiandaitwa azwo o ṅwaliwaho phanḓa ha tsheo
registers.change_sub: Ṅwala masiandaitwa phanḓa ha tsheo — ndi zwone zwine zwa ita uri tsheo i vhe na ṱhalutshedzo.
registers.no_risks: A hu na khombo kha ino projeke.
registers.no_risks_hint: Projeke i si na khombo dzo ṅwaliwaho a si projeke i si na khombo.
registers.no_issues: A hu na tshithu tshi salaho.
registers.no_changes: A hu na khumbelo dza tshanduko.
registers.no_changes_hint: U shandukisa tshedza nnṱha ha tshone a zwi siyi tshithu tsha u vhambedza phambano natsho.
registers.strategy_hint: U iledza hu bvisa tshiitisi; u fhirisela hu i fhirisela kha muṅwe, kanzhi nga khonokoto kana nga inshurannsi.
registers.kind_hint: Tshiitea tshi fanela u ṅwala tshiitisi tshatsho tsha mutheo phanḓa ha uri tshi valwe.
registers.mitigation_hint: Ndayo i dzhiwaho zwino uri i si itee nga u leluwa kana i si vhe mmbi ngauralo.
registers.field_contingency: Zwine ra ḓo zwi ita arali ya itea naho zwo ralo
registers.contingency_hint: Tshedza tshine wa vhuyelela khatsho. U tshi ṅwala zwino ndi tshiṱaṱhelo tshiṱuku u fhira u tshi ṅwala nga tshenetsho tshifhinga.
registers.review_hint: Khombo i si na muthu ane a i ṱolisisa ndi khombo i si na muṋe.
registers.closure_hint: Yo fhira, yo langwa, kana yo ṱanganedzwa — amba uri ndi ifhio.
registers.task_hint: A zwi kombetshedzwi. Zwi ṱumanya thaidzo na mushumo une ya u kwama.
registers.corrective_hint: Zwe zwa itwa u lugisa vhuimo uhu.
registers.preventative_hint: Zwine zwa thivhela uri zwi si dovhe zwa itea.
registers.root_cause_required: Hetshi ndi tshiitea kana thaidzo ya ndeme, nga zwenezwo tshiitisi tsha mutheo tshi fanela u ṅwaliwa phanḓa ha uri i valwe.
registers.reason_hint: Ndi zwone zwine wa tendelaho a zwi vhala u thoma.
registers.impact_note: Amba zwine ya zwi ita kha vhuphara, mitengo, tshifhinga na ndeme. Sia bogisi ḽi si na tshithu arali u sa ḓivhi zwa vhukuma — 0 i sa ambi tshithu i fhungudza tshanduko fhedzi arali muṅwe a i tendela.
registers.impact_days_hint: Nomboro i re fhasi ha ziro i sendedza ḓuvha.
registers.realise_note: Khombo i sala kha mutevhe sa yo iteaho, ngeno thaidzo ntswa i tshi sumbedza murahu khayo — u ṱangana honoho ndi vhuṱanzi ha uri ho vha na muthu we a i vhona i tshi ḓa.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} i ya kha vhoṱhe vhane vha tendela tshanduko kha ino projeke. A ni nga koni u i shandukisa musi i tshi kha ḓi ṱolisiswa.
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} i a shumiswa nahone hu dzhiiwa mutheo, uri masiandaitwa ayo kha tshifhinga a kone u elwa nga murahu.
registers.close_needs_note: Amba uri khombo i valwa ngauri.
registers.needs_root_cause: Tshiitea kana thaidzo ya ndeme i fanela u ṅwala tshiitisi tshayo tsha mutheo.
registers.change_not_editable: Iyo khumbelo ya tshanduko i kha ane a tendela.
registers.change_not_approved: Ndi tshanduko yo tendelwaho fhedzi ine ya nga shumiswa.
registers.no_flow_auto: A hu na nḓila ya thendelo yo vhewaho khumbelo dza tshanduko kha ino nzudzanyo ya mushumo, nga zwenezwo yo ṅwaliwa sa yo tendelwaho.

portfolio.title: Photifoliyo
portfolio.subtitle: Mbekanyamushumo na diprojeke, na zwine zwa shumiswa ngazwo.
portfolio.portfolio_hint: Tshigwada tsha mbekanyamushumo na diprojeke dzi tatisanaho nga tshelede i fanaho.
portfolio.programme_hint: Tshigwada tsha diprojeke dzi ḓisaho mvelelo nthihi khathihi.
portfolio.empty_title: A hu na tshithu tsho ṱanganyiswaho zwino
portfolio.empty_body: Mbekanyamushumo ndi tshigwada tsha diprojeke dzi ḓisaho mvelelo nthihi — sibadela: vhufhaṱi, IT na vhashumi. Photifoliyo ndi tshigwada tsha mbekanyamushumo na diprojeke dzi tatisanaho nga tshelede i fanaho. Zwoṱhe a zwi kombetshedzwi: arali ni tshi ita mishumo i songo tshimbidzanaho, a ni ṱoḓi naho ndi ifhio.
portfolio.no_projects: A hu na diprojeke kha ino mbekanyamushumo zwino.
portfolio.direct: Nga ho livhaho kha ino photifoliyo
portfolio.unassigned_sub: Dzo sumbedzwa uri nomboro i re nṱha i si dzi hangwe nga u fhumula.
portfolio.budget_hint: Zwine ino photifoliyo ya nga zwi shumisa. Nnṱha hazwo a hu na tshithu tsha u vhambedza natsho.
portfolio.outcome_hint: Mutaladzo muthihi. Mbekanyamushumo i si na mvelelo nthihi ndi photifoliyo nga ḽiṅwe dzina.
portfolio.assign_note: Projeke i re kha mbekanyamushumo i dzhia photifoliyo ya iyo mbekanyamushumo nga yone — phindulo mbili kha “ndi ifhio photifoliyo” ndi nḓila ine dzinomboro dza sa lingane ngayo.

templates.title: Thempuleithi dza projeke
templates.subtitle: Hune projeke ntswa ya nga thoma hone, uri zwipiḓa zwine vhathu vha zwi hangwa zwi vhe hone.
templates.capture_sub: Shandukisa mushumo wo tshimbilaho zwavhuḓi u vhe mathomo a u tevhelaho.
templates.capture_note: Maḓuvha a vhulungwa sa zwikhala u bva mathomoni a projeke, hu si sa maḓuvha a khalenda — thempuleithi i re na maḓuvha a vhukuma ndi ngoho nga ḓuvha ḽe ya ṅwaliwa ngaḽo nahone i khakha maṅwe maḓuvha oṱhe a tevhelaho.
templates.none_hint: Dzhia projeke yo tshimbilaho zwavhuḓi, nahone i tevhelaho i thome khayo.
templates.sub_type_hint: Nnḓu, dziṱaraṱa, ERP, khamphenyi — naho vhathu vha tshi zwi vhidza hani.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} a i tsha ḓo ṋewa. Diprojeke dzo itwaho ngayo a dzi kwamei.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} ndi thempuleithi yo rumelwaho, nga zwenezwo i a dzumbiwa nṱhani ha u i dzima — u i dzima ho vha hu tshi ḓo vhuya kha u khwiniswa ho tevhelaho.
templates.start_from_sub: Ino projeke a i athu vha na tshedza, nga zwenezwo tshi nga vhewa nṱha hayo.

gates.title: Khoro dza zwipiḓa
gates.subtitle: Zwine zwa fanela u vha ngoho phanḓa ha uri ino projeke i bvele phanḓa.
gates.field_criteria: Zwine zwa fanela u vha ngoho
gates.criteria_hint: Zwo ṅwaliwa phanḓa ha tsheo, hu si nga murahu hayo.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Khoro yo siiwaho i fanela u amba uri ndi ngani. U fhira iṅwe nnṱha ha tshiitisi ndi muvhigo u dzimiwaho zwiṱuku nga zwiṱuku.
gates.none: A hu na khoro kha ino projeke.
gates.none_hint: Nnṱha ha nthihi, tshipiḓa ndi leibula ḽine muṅwe a ḽi shandukisa.

site_records.title: Maṅwalo a fhethu ha mushumo
site_records.subtitle: Ndaela, ṱhoḓisiso, ṱhoḓulusiso na u fhelela — maṅwalo ane khumbelo ya ambiwa ngao.
site_records.instructions_sub: Zwe wa vhudzwa uri u ite, lini, na nnyi
site_records.tests_sub: Sampula dzo dzhiiwaho, na zwe laboratori ya zwi amba
site_records.inspections_sub: “Iḓani ni ḓo sedza phanḓa ha uri ndi tibe”
site_records.completion_sub: Nga u shuma, nga zwipiḓa na nga u fhedza — thifikeiti dzine dza vhofholola tshelede yo vhulungwaho
site_records.unconverted_title: Ndaela dza {count} dzo humbelwaho sa tshanduko ngeno dzi songo itwa tshanduko
site_records.unconverted_body: Ndi hune tshelede ya xela hone kha akhaunthe ya u fhedza. Dzi iteni tshanduko, kana ni bvise khumbelo.
site_records.overdue_inspections: Ṱhoḓulusiso dza {count} dzo humbelwaho ngeno dzi songo ṅwaliwa
site_records.no_instructions: A hu na ndaela dzo ṅwaliwaho.
site_records.no_instructions_hint: “No ri vhudza” ndi khani fhedzi arali hu na tsumbo na ḓuvha.
site_records.no_tests: A hu na sampula dzo ṅwaliwaho.
site_records.no_inspections: A hu na ṱhoḓulusiso dzo humbelwaho.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: U fhirwa nga nthihi ndi zwone zwine zwa shandukisa mushumo wo fheleaho uri u vhe mushumo u faneleaho u dovha wa vulwa.
site_records.no_completion: A hu na tshithu tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho zwino.
site_records.no_completion_hint: U fhelela nga u shuma hu thoma tshifhinga tsha zwikhakhisi nahone kanzhi hu vhofholola hafu ya tshelede yo vhulungwaho.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Muenjiniere kana muimeleli wa mureṅgi — kanzhi hu si muthu a re na akhaunthe hafha.
site_records.field_instruction: Zwe wa vhudzwa uri u ite
site_records.variation_hint: Ṅwala mbono yau zwino, hu si nga miṅwedzi i ḓaho musi akhaunthe i tshi hanedzwa.
site_records.instruction_sub: Yo ṋewa phanḓa ha uri muṅwe a tende uri ndi tshanduko — ndi ndivho yayo.
site_records.element_hint: “Mutheo wa fhasi, tshikhala 3” — zwo linganela u i wana hafhu.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Ṱhoḓisiso yo kundelwaho i vula u sa tevhedza milayo nga yone. Zwe zwa shelwa nṱha hazwo zwo no tibiwa, nga zwenezwo hezwi a zwi siiwi kha tsheo ya muṅwe.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Ṱhoḓulusiso i ṱoḓeaho ṋamusi madekwana a si ndivhadzo.
site_records.inspection_sub: Yo humbelwa phanḓa ha uri mushumo u tibiwe.
site_records.outstanding_hint: Mutevhe u tshimbilaho na thifikeiti. U fhelela nga u shuma hu ṋewa hu tshee na mushumo u salaho — zwenezwo ndi zwa ḓowelea.
site_records.certify_sub: Hezwi zwi vhofholola tshelede yo vhulungwaho nahone zwi thoma watshi ya zwikhakhisi.
site_records.certify_note: U fhelela nga u shuma hu hanelwa arali hu na tshikhakhisi tsha ndeme kana u sa tevhedza milayo ho vulaho kha mutevhe — u khwaṱhisedza nṱha hazwo hu lozwa tshibuli tsha u zwi lugisa.
site_records.completion_blocked: Hu na tshikhakhisi tsha ndeme kana u sa tevhedza milayo ho vulaho ha {count}. U fhelela nga u shuma a hu nga khwaṱhisedzwi nṱha hazwo.
site_records.already_a_variation: Iyo ndaela i no vha na khumbelo ya tshanduko.
site_records.raised_from_si: I bva kha ndaela ya fhethu {number}.
site_records.failed_test_body: Mvelelo {result} u lwa na zwo ambiwaho zwa {specified} {unit}.

meetings.title: Miṱangano
meetings.subtitle: Mutevhe, maṅwalo, uri ndi nnyi we a vha hone, na zwine zwa fanela u itwa ngazwo.
meetings.project_hint: Nyito dzi nga vha mishumo kha projeke fhedzi, nga zwenezwo muṱangano u si nayo u vhulunga nyito dzawo kha maṅwalo.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Miṱangano ya {count} yo farwaho nnṱha ha uri maṅwalo a phaḓaladzwe
meetings.minutes_outstanding_body: Ndi hune tsheo dza ngala hone nga u fhumula.
meetings.actions_n: nyito dza {open} dzo vulaho kha dza {total}
meetings.agenda_hint: U rumelwa phanḓa ha muṱangano; u vha tshivhumbeo tsha maṅwalo.
meetings.minutes_note: Zwi re ngomu zwi ṅwaliwa na maṅwalo nga ndivho: “ho tendelanwa kha muṱangano wa fhethu ha mushumo” ndi khani fhedzi arali ḽiṅwalo ḽi tshi amba uri ndi nnyi we a vha hone u tendelana nazwo.
meetings.attendance: Ndi nnyi we a vha hone
meetings.actions_note: Nyito dzi vha mishumo kha projeke — nyito i tshilaho kha maṅwalo fhedzi ndi nyito i si na muthu ane a i ita.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” na maṅwalo awo zwi a bviswa. Nyito dzo no itwa dzi vha mishumo.

agile.title: Sprint na mutevhe wo lindelaho
agile.subtitle: Mafhungo ndi mishumo ya ḓowelea, nga zwenezwo bodo, tshedza na maṅwalo a tshifhinga zwoṱhe zwi kha ḓi shuma.
agile.backlog_sub: Zwi songo dzudzanywaho zwi ya fhasi — tshithu tshi si na muthu a tshi vhea phanḓa a tshi tsha vha tsha ndeme u fhira.
agile.epics_sub: Mushumo u fhiraho sprint. Mvelaphanḓa ndi mafhungo azwo, hu si tshiero tsho fhambanaho tshine tsha nga sa tendelani nazwo.
agile.releases_sub: Zwo bvaho, na zwe zwa vha zwi khazwo.
agile.no_active: A hu na sprint i khou bvela phanḓa.
agile.no_active_hint: Dzudzanya iṅwe, dzhenisa mafhungo khayo, nahone u i thome.
agile.no_backlog: A hu na tshithu kha mutevhe wo lindelaho.
agile.no_releases: A hu na u bviswa ho dzudzanywaho.
agile.no_goal: A hu na ndivho yo vhewaho — sprint i si nayo ndi bogisi ḽa tshifhinga fhedzi.
agile.remaining_of: Phoinṱi dza {remaining} dzi salaho kha dza {committed}
agile.stories_done: Mafhungo a {done} o fheleaho kha a {total}
agile.burndown: Girafu ya u fhelela ha sprint
agile.goal_hint: Mutaladzo muthihi. Arali ni sa koni u u ṅwala, sprint a i na ndivho.
agile.revision_hint: Nnṱha hazwo, “ho vha na mini kha ulu lushaka” ndi u humbula kha miṅwedzi ya rathi i ḓaho.
agile.close_note: Mafhungo a sa athu fhela a vhuyelela kha mutevhe wo lindelaho, hu si phanḓa ha sprint i tevhelaho — u a fhirisela nga oṋe ndi nḓila ine sprint i tevhelaho ya thoma ngayo yo no ḓala phanḓa ha uri muṅwe a i dzudzanye.
agile.one_at_a_time: Iṅwe sprint i no khou bvela phanḓa kha ino projeke. Mbili nga tshifhinga tshithihi dzi ita uri luvhilo na girafu ya u fhelela zwi sa pfale.
agile.not_active: Ndi sprint i khou bvela phanḓa fhedzi ine ya nga valwa.
agile.closed_note: {name} yo valwa: phoinṱi dza {completed} dzo fhelela kha dza {committed}.

portal.title: Diprojeke dzaṋu
portal.subtitle: Zwine zwa itea kha mishumo yaṋu, na zwine zwa ṱoḓa inwi.
portal.empty_title: A hu na tshithu hafha tsha vhoiwe
portal.empty_body: Iyi phothali i sumbedza diprojeke dzine na tshimbidzana nadzo sa mureṅgi kana sa khonokoto. Arali ni tshi shuma hafha, diprojeke dzaṋu dzi nga fhasi ha Diprojeke.
portal.awaiting_title: Zwithu zwa {count} zwo lindela tsheo yaṋu
portal.progress_note: Iyi ndi nomboro i fanaho na ine tshigwada tshi shumaho tsha i vhona — a i vhalwi nga nḓila yo fhambanaho kha inwi.
portal.no_milestones: A hu na zwipiḓa zwo vhewaho.
portal.changes_sub: Tshanduko kha vhuphara, mitengo kana maḓuvha
portal.no_work: A hu na tshithu tsho ṋewaho inwi zwino.
portal.hours_this_month: Awara dza {n} dzo ṅwaliwaho ṅwedzini uno
portal.time_sub: Zwi fhira kha thendelo i fanaho na ya siaṱari ḽa tshifhinga ḽa muthu muṅwe na muṅwe.
portal.claims_sub: Zwo khwaṱhisedzwaho, na zwi tshee zwi tshi ṱolisiswa

data_sources.title: Zwiko zwa data
data_sources.subtitle: Zwiko zwine khamphani iyi ya khwaṱhisedza vhaṋekedzi ngazwo, zwine tshiko tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha nga zwi fhindula, na ṱhoḓisiso dzine ha si vhe na muthu a nga dzi fhindulaho.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Tshiimo tsha vhuṱanzi a tshi tendelani kha tshiṅwalwa tsha {at} ({reason}). Dzhiani vhuṱanzi vhu kwamaho sa vhu songo khwaṱhisedzwaho u swika hu tshi ṱoḓisiswa.
data_sources.coverage_help: Ṱhoḓisiso iṅwe na iṅwe ine modulu iyi ya ḓivha u i ita, na uri ndi nnyi ane a i fhindula ṋamusi. Ṱhoḓisiso i si na tshiko a i fhirwi — i ṅwaliswa sa i sa wanali u swika muthu a tshi i ita nahone a ṅwalisa zwe a zwi wana.
data_sources.manual_notice: Ṱhoḓisiso dza {count} a dzi na tshiko tsho dzudzanywaho, ngauralo muthu u tea u dzi ita nahone a ṅwalisa zwe a zwi wana.
data_sources.enable_help: Musi hezwi zwo dzimiwa, ṱhoḓisiso dzine dza vha dzi tshi ḓo fhindulwa dzi ṅwaliswa sa dzi sa wanali nṱhani ha uri dzi fhire.
data_sources.credentials_help: Zwo tsireledzwa hune zwa vhewa hone nahone a zwi vhuyi zwa vhuyedzedzwa kha tshikirini itshi. Dzhenisani khiye u i shandukisa; khiye dzine na si dzi ṅwale hafhu dzi a vhewa.
data_sources.enabled_checks: Ṱhoḓisiso dzine tshiko itshi tsha nga dzi fhindula
data_sources.default_for_help: Hune zwiko zwo fhiraho tshithihi zwa nga fhindula ṱhoḓisiso, itshi tshi vhudziswa u thoma.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Zwiko zwine zwa lifhelwa zwi ḽa tshelede nga tshiḓaḓo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. Musi tshipiḓa tsho fhela, ṱhoḓisiso dzi ṅwaliswa sa dzi sa wanali nṱhani ha u ni lifhisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Ḓiresi ine akhaunthu yaṋu yo tendelwaho ya i ṋea kha ṱhoḓisiso iṅwe na iṅwe. Fhethu ha u ḓadza hu ḓadzwa u bva kha muṋekedzi.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Fhethu ha u ḓadza: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Tshi dzula tshi tshi wanala. Muthu u ita ṱhoḓisiso kha tshiko nahone a ṅwalisa zwe a zwi wana — zwi dzhena kha bugu i fanaho ya zwiṱaluli, na tshiṅwalwa tsha vhuṱanzi tshi fanaho, zwo ṅwaliswa kha dzina ḽawe.
data_sources.none_match: A hu na tshiko tshi tendelanaho na zwenezwo.

data_sources.profiled: U tola ha {count} vho no ḍivha hune vha fonela hone. Dzheniseni zwitadulo zwanu nahone zwi ḓo shuma — masimu a fhasi ndi a konteraka yo fhambanaho fhedzi.

safety_file.site_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu arali lu shuma kha fhethu hoṱhe. Luṅwalo lwa fhethu ho tiwaho a lu tei u thivhela mukonteraka kha fhethu huṅwe.
safety_file.activities_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu arali lu shuma kha mishumo yoṱhe. Thikithi ya u imisa i na ndeme kha u imisa, hu si kha u penda.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Lwo ṋewa zwi amba uri lwo swika nahone muthu u kha ḓi tea u lu ṱolisisa. A lu khunyeledzi tshithu u swikela lu tshi ṱanganedzwa.

state_hint.DRAFT: A hu na muthu o humbelwaho u sedza faela heyi.
state_hint.SUBMITTED: Yo ṋewa nahone i lindela muthu ane a ḓo i dzhia.
state_hint.UNDER_REVIEW: Muthu u na yone nahone u khou i sedzulusa.
state_hint.CHANGES_REQUIRED: Yo vhuyedzedzwa. Zwine zwi tevhela zwine zwi rumelwa ndi vhesheni ntswa.
state_hint.APPROVED: Muthu a re na vhukoni o ṱanganedza faela heyi. I ima u shuma nga ḓuvha ḽi re afho fhasi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: A i hanwi, fhedzi a i shumi. Vhathu vhavho vha hanwa khoroni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Thendelo yo fhela. Faela ntswa i tea u rumelwa.
state_hint.BLOCKED: Yo hanwa. Faela ntswa i tea u rumelwa.

move_hint.submit: I ṋea faela kha naho ndi nnyi ane a ṱolisisa dzifaela dza vhakonteraka hafha. A i nga si rumelwe musi tshipida tshine tshi ṱoḓwa tshi songo khunyeledzwa.
move_hint.request_changes: I i vhuyedzedza na mutevhe wa zwine zwi tea u shanduka. Zwine zwi tevhela zwine zwi rumelwa nga mukonteraka ndi vhesheni ntswa, nahone heyi i vhulunga tshiitisi tshaṋu.
move_hint.approve: I ṱanganedza faela samusi i imaho ṋamusi. Thendelo ndi mafhungo nga ha maṅwalo a re ngomu nga ḓuvha heḽi, ngauralo i hwala ḓuvha ḽa u fhela.
move_hint.suspend: I imisa thendelo u shuma hu si na u hana faela. Vhathu vhavho vha hanwa khoroni u swikela i tshi vhuyedzedzwa.

doc_status.SUPPLIED: Lwo ṋewa, a lu ngo ṱanganedzwa

safety_file.may_work: Vhathu vhavho vha nga shuma fhethu.
safety_file.not_blocking: A zwo ngo luga, fhedzi a zwi hani u dzhena
safety_file.rules_hint: Tsheo yaṋu, hu si ya sisiteme. Tshiimo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi re afho fhasi tshi ṱolisiswa nahone tshi vhigwa naho hu hani; zwiswishi hezwi zwi khetha uri tshifhio tshazwo tshi hana vhukuma mukonteraka khoroni. Zwi shuma kha mukonteraka muṅwe na muṅwe, ngauri u zwi shumisa nga nḓila i si yavhuḓi ndi nga zwone khaedu khoroni i bvelelaho.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Zwoṱhe zwine zwi ṱoḓwa zwi kha faela, a zwo ngo fhela nahone zwo ṱanganedzwa.
status_hint.EXPIRING: A hu na tshithu tshi shaeaho, fhedzi tshiṅwe tshithu tshi fhela tshifhinga hu si kale.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Tshiṅwe tshithu tshine tshi ṱoḓwa a tsho ngo luga. No khetha u sa hana u dzhena nga ṅwambo watsho.
status_hint.BLOCKED: Tshiimo tshine ni thivhela ngatsho a tsho ngo swikelelwa.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Faela i kha muṱolisisi. A hu na tshithu tshi shaeaho — a hu na muthu o i ṱanganedza.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Muthu o imisa faela heyi. Zwenezwo zwi fhira zwoṱhe zwo vhalwaho.

activities.title: Mishumo
activities.subtitle: Mushumo u itwaho fhethu, na uri lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe lu ṱoḓa mini uri lu tendelwe.
activities.name: Dzina
activities.code_hint: Zwine tshivhali tsha khadi, thendelo kana API zwa zwi rumela. Maḽeḓere mahulu, hu si na vhuponi.
activities.requires_hint: Vhuṱanzi vhune muthu a fanela u vha naho. Mushumi a si na vhuṅwe havho u hanwa uyu mushumo nga dzina.
activities.requires_nothing: A hu na vhukoni ho khetheaho
activities.who_can: Ndi nnyi ane a nga u ita
activities.nobody_qualified: A hu na ane a tea
activities.high_risk_hint: Zwi u swaya uri u sedzuluswe hafhu. Heke i shuma nga zwine mushumo wa zwi ṱoḓa, hu si nga hezwi.
activities.permit_label: I ṱoḓa thendelo ya u shuma
activities.permit_hint: Thendelo i fanela u vulwa hu saathu thoma uyu mushumo.
activities.retire_body: A u tsha ṋewa. Thendelo na zwiitea zwa u dzhena zwo no ṅwaliwaho khawo zwi dzula zwi tshi vhalea, nahone khoudu i nga dovha ya shumiswa nga murahu.
activities.no_match: A hu na mushumo u tshimbidzanaho na zwenezwo.
activities.empty_title: A hu na tshithu kha mutevhe zwino
activities.empty_body: U swika mushumo u tshi amba zwine wa zwi ṱoḓa, heke ine ya vhudziswa uri “naa uyu muthu a nga shuma nṱha” a i na tshithu tshine ya nga tshi ṱola nahone i tendela vhoṱhe. Thomani nga mutevhe wa Afrika Tshipembe u ḓaho ni shandukise zwine muṅwe na muṅwe a zwi ṱoḓa.
activities.unstaffed: Mishumo ya {n} ine hu si na muthu fhethu ane a tea khayo zwino. Kana zwiṱifikeithi zwi fanela u ṱoḓiwa, kana ṱhoḓea a yo ngo luga.
activities.advisory_title: Vhukoni vhu siho vhu a ṅwaliwa, a vhu hanwi
activities.advisory_body: Muthu a si na vhuṱanzi vhu ṱoḓeaho u a fhiriswa nahone tshikhala tshi a ṅwaliwa. Vulani “Vhukoni vhu siho ha mushumo” kha milayo ya u thivhela vhakonteraka uri hu hanwe nṱhani hazwo.

attendance.title: Fhethu ha mushumo
attendance.subtitle: Ndi nnyi ane a vha hafha zwino, ndi nnyi o dzhenaho a bva, na ane a si vhuye a saina musi a tshi bva.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Vhathu vha {n} vho no vha fhethu tshifhinga tshi fhiraho awara dza {hours}. Shifiti ya vhusiku na yone i vhonala nga ngona — fhedzi na fhethu hune ha si na ane a saina musi a tshi bva.
attendance.nobody_on_site: A hu na we a saina a dzhena.
attendance.no_movements: A hu na mitshimbilo yo ṅwaliwaho.
attendance.no_site: A hu na fhethu ho ṅwaliwaho
attendance.no_employer: A hu na muṋe wa mushumo o ṅwaliwaho
attendance.search: Ṱoḓani nga dzina, muṋe wa mushumo kana mushumo
attendance.when_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu uri hu vhe zwino. Tshifhinga tsho fhiraho tshi a ṱanganedzwa, u ṅwala mutevhe wa bammbiri; tshi ḓaho a tshi ṱanganedzwi.
attendance.manual_note: Zwi ṅwaliwa sa zwo dzheniswaho nga tshanḓa, uri oditi i kone u zwi fhambanya na u skena. Tshivhali tshi sa shumi a si tshiitisi tsha u sia muthu kha mutevhe.
attendance.everyone_in: Vhoṱhe vha re kha mutevhe vho no dzhena.
attendance.nobody_to_sign_out: A hu na we a saina a dzhena.
attendance.monitor_only: O vha a tshi ḓo hanwa — heke iyi i kha maitele a u sedzulusa.

overrides.title: U dzhena ha tshifhinganyana
overrides.subtitle: Ndi nnyi o tendelwaho u fhira heke ye a vha a songo fanela u i fhira, na nga maanḓa a nnyi.
overrides.explainer: Thendelo yo khetheaho i ṱanganedza muthu ane faela yawe i si kha ndugiselo. Yo itwa uri zwi leluwe u i ṋea — mukonteraka a re na mushumo a si na nḓila ya u dzhena ndi nḓila ine vhathu vha saina ngayo nga dzina ḽa khonani — nahone yo tsireledzea ngauri iṅwe na iṅwe yo ṅwaliwa hafha na tshiitisi tshayo, we a i ṱanganedza na magumo ayo. A hu na ine ya nga shuma tshifhinga tshi fhiraho maḓuvha a {days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Hezwi zwi dzhenisa fhethu muthu we a vha a tshi ḓo hanwa. Zwi ṅwaliwa nga dzina ḽaṋu, na nga dzina ḽa we a ṱanganedza ane na mu bula.
overrides.ending_soon: I fhela nga fhasi ha awara dza 48
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Thendelo dza {n} dzi fhela nga maḓuvha mavhili. Dzi khwinifhadzeni kana ni dzi litshe dzi fhele — fhedzi dzhiani tsheo, nṱhani ha u dzi wana hekeni.
overrides.search: Ṱoḓani nga muthu, tshiitisi kana we a ṱanganedza
overrides.show_closed: Sumbedzani dzo fhelaho na dzo koloswaho
overrides.none_open: A hu na tshithu tsho fhiriswaho zwino.
overrides.none_ever: A hu na thendelo yo khetheaho yo vhuyaho ya ṋewa.
overrides.reason_hint: Zwine muthu a sedzaho hezwi nga miṅwedzi ya rathi a ḓo zwi shumisa. Zwiṱoka zwa fhasi-fhasi zwa fumi.
overrides.conditions_hint: Zwine vha fanela u zwi ita musi i tshi kha ḓi shuma. Zwi gandiswa kha tsheo ya heke musi khadi ḽavho ḽi tshi skenwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu uri i thome zwino. Thendelo ya u vala mushumo i nga dzudzanywa ḓuvha ḽo fhiraho.
overrides.ends_hint: Hu a ṱoḓea, nahone maḓuvha a {days} fhedzi a ḓaho. I ḓi vala nga yoṱhe.
overrides.site_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu kha fhethu hoṱhe. U i fhungudza ndi khetho yo tsireledzeaho.
overrides.activity_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu kha mushumo woṱhe.
overrides.approver_hint: Muthu we a i tendela, arali hu si inwi. Litshani hu si na tshithu nahone i ṅwaliwe nga dzina ḽaṋu.
overrides.revoke_body: Heke i humela hune ya vha hone, nga u ṱavhanya. Muṅwe na muṅwe o ḓitika nga hezwi u dzhena fhethu matshelo u ḓo hanwa.
overrides.revoke_reason: Ndi ngani ni tshi i kolosa

notices.subtitle: Zwine sisiteme iyi ya zwi vhudza vhakonteraka vhaṋu, hune zwa ya hone, na zwe zwa vhuya zwa rumelwa.

settings.chains_explainer: Khethani i ṱalutshedza uri i shuma lini. U tshimbidzana ho livhaho hu a kunda, uri khumbelo i fanaho i tshimbile nga nḓila i fanaho tshifhinga tshoṱhe.
settings.is_default: Shumisa musi hu si na iṅwe khethani i tshimbidzanaho
settings.is_default_hint: Nthihi ya mathomo kha thoho iṅwe na iṅwe i ita uri khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe i vhe na nḓila.
settings.no_notification_rules: A hu na milayo ya ndivhadzo yo dzudzanywaho.
settings.no_categories: A hu na zwigwada zwa manwalo zwo dzudzanywaho.
settings.requires_expiry: Ḓuvha ḽa u fhela ḽi a ṱoḓea
settings.retire_chain_body: Khethani i imisa u rumela khumbelo ntswa. Tsheo dze dza no dzhielwa ngayo dzi vhulunga rekhodo yadzo, nahone a hu na tshithu tsho no tendelwa tshi shandukaho.
settings.chain_edit_warning: Khumbelo dza {n} zwino dzi fhira kha ino khethani
settings.code_hint: Khoudu pfufhi yo khetheaho, tsu. HIGH_VALUE.
settings.code_locked_hint: Khoudu i sumbedza ino khethani nahone a i nga shandukiswi.
settings.steps_hint: Thendelo dzi itea nga ndila iyi. Shandukisa u tevhekana nga misevhe.
settings.single_approver_hint: Muthu muthihi o bulwaho u saina ḽino gwada.
settings.approver_derived_hint: Muṱanganedzi u wanala nga khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe.
settings.preference_explainer: Zwivhumbeo zwa u nangwa zwi sumbedza uri mukhumbeli u wana masheleni mangana nga nnḓa ha mutengo. Fomula ya mutengo yo vhewa nga mulayo; maphuzu o vhewa nga pholisi yaṋu, ngauralo tafula ḽo zwaliwaho ndi mathomo u swika ni tshi ḽi khwaṱhisedza.
settings.jurisdiction_title: Vhulanguli na u shandukiswa ha tshelede
settings.jurisdiction_hint: Hu shumiswa musi thendara i sa ambi hayo.
settings.fx_basis: Shandukisa khumbelo ni tshi shumisa tshikalo tsha
settings.fx_basis_hint: Ndi tshikalo tsha ḓuvha ḽifhio tshine tsha vhambedza khumbelo dza tshelede dzo fhambanaho.
settings.fx_basis_closing: Ḓuvha ḽa u valwa ha thendara
settings.fx_basis_evaluation: Ḓuvha ḽa u thoma ha u sengulusa
settings.fx_basis_submission: Ḓuvha ḽa u rumela ḽa khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe
settings.fx_basis_submission_warning: U shandukisa khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe nga ḓuvha ḽayo ḽa u rumela zwi amba uri khumbelo mbili dzi fanaho dzi nga vha kha vhuimo ho fhambanaho fhedzi nga uri dzo swika nga maḓuvha o fhambanaho.
settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Zwi tshimbidzana na lushaka lwo vhulungwaho kha Finance, kanzhi ndi spot.
settings.no_frameworks: A hu na zwivhumbeo zwa u nangwa zwo dzudzanywaho.
settings.framework_no_bands: A hu na mibande yo vhewaho. A hu na tshine tsha ḓo ṋewa nga fhasi ha hetshi tshivhumbeo u swika i tshi vhewa.
settings.retire_framework_body: Tshivhumbeo a tshi tsha ṋewa kha dzithendara ntswa. Dzithendara dze dza no ṋewa maphuzu ngatsho dzi vhulunga rekhodo yadzo.
settings.basis_hint: Maphuzu a ṋea mbadelo; mukano u ṋea mbuyelo ya mutengo vhudzuloni hazwo.
settings.split_hint: Mutengo na u nangwa zwi fanela u vha 100.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Hezwi zwo thewa kha mini, na zwine zwa kha ḓi ṱoḓa u khwaṱhisedzwa.
settings.bands_hint: Zwi ṱolwa nga u tevhekana; mubande wa u thoma une mukhumbeli a tshimbidzana nawo ndi wone u shumaho.
settings.band_value_hint: tsu. 1, kana <=2 kha vhuimo 2 kana khwine
settings.field_local_content: I tevhedza zwi re ngomu ha shango
settings.confirm_verified: Ndi khwaṱhisedza uri idzi nomboro dzi tshimbidzana na pholisi yashu ya u renga yo tendelwaho
settings.confirm_verified_hint: Zwi ṅwalwa nga fhasi ha dzina ḽaṋu. U lugisa nomboro nga murahu zwi phumula hezwi u swika zwi tshi ṋewa hafhu.
settings.confirm_verified_note: Hetshi tshivhumbeo tshi ḓo swayiwa sa tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho, nga dzina ḽaṋu, musi ni tshi vhulunga.

portal.no_closing_date: A hu na ḓuvha ḽa u vala ḽo vhewaho
portal.registration_number: Nomboro ya u ṅwalisa ha khamphani
portal.local_content: Iyi khumbelo i swikelela ṱhoḓea ya zwi re ngomu ha shango
portal.notes: Manwalwa a komiti ya u sengulusa
portal.confirm: Ndi khwaṱhisedza uri iyi khumbelo yo luga nahone i rumelwa nga dzina ḽa khamphani yo bulwaho afho nṱha
portal.confirm_hint: Musi yo no rumelwa, khumbelo yaṋu i a valwa nahone a i nga shandukiswi. Kwamani mushumeli wa u renga arali ni tshi ṱoḓa u i shandukisa.
portal.closed_warning: Iyi thendara yo no valwa. Ni nga kha ḓi rumela, fhedzi khumbelo yaṋu i ḓo ṅwalwa sa yo lengaho nahone ndi komiti ine ya ḓo dzhia tsheo ya uri i nga sedzwa naa.
portal.received: Khumbelo yaṋu yo valwa nahone ya ṱanganedzwa
portal.received_body: I dzula yo valwa u swika thendara i tshi valwa, nahone i vulwa khathihi na dziṅwe khumbelo dzoṱhe nga vhashumeli vhavhili.
portal.received_late: Khumbelo yaṋu yo ṱanganedzwa nga murahu ha tshifhinga tsha u vala
portal.received_late_body: Yo ṅwalwa sa yo lengaho. Uri khumbelo yo lengaho i nga sedzwa naa ndi tsheo ya komiti nga fhasi ha milayo yayo.
portal.receipt_hint: I vhulungeni. I sumbedza khumbelo yaṋu ni sa i bvisi khagala.
portal.footer: Yo rumelwa nga Mkhaya Hub. Ili lidzhia ndi ḽaṋu fhedzi — ni songo ḽi kovhekanya.

intake.explainer: Vhakhumbeli vho rambiwaho vha rumela nga lidzhia ḽavho. Khumbelo dzi dzula dzo valwa u swika thendara i tshi valwa, nahone dzoṱhe dzi vulwa khathihi nga vhashumeli vhavhili.
intake.invite_hint: Zwi sika lidzhia ḽa tshiphiri ḽa uyu mukhumbeli. Mu rumeleni ḽone — ndi yone fhedzi nḓila yawe ya u dzhena.
intake.none_invited: A hu na vhakhumbeli vho rambiwaho zwino.
intake.link_ready: Lidzhia ḽa u rambiwa ḽo sikwa
intake.link_once: Ḽo sumbedzwa luthihi. Ḽi kopeni zwino — a ḽi nga tsha sumbedzwa hafhu.
intake.withdraw_body: Khumbelo yo valwaho i a bviswa uri uyu mukhumbeli a kone u rumela hafhu. Zwoṱhe zwivhili u bviswa na khumbelo ntswa zwi dzula kha nḓila ya nkambelo.
intake.opening_explainer: Khumbelo dzoṱhe dzo valwaho dzi vulwa nga tshifhinga tshithihi, nga inwi na ṱhanzi. U vula hu itea luthihi nahone a hu nga humiselwi murahu.
intake.open_warning: Khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe yo valwaho i a vhalea nga uyu muthethe, nahone a hu nga humiselwi murahu. Bvelani phanḓa fhedzi arali ṱhanzi yaṋu i hone.
intake.witness_hint: Muthu wa vhuvhili, ane a vha hone musi hu tshi vulwa, o ṅwalwaho kha thendara.

analytics.title: Musengulusi wa u renga
analytics.subtitle: Nḓila ine modulu yoṱhe ya shuma ngayo, hu si fhedzi zwe ya zwi shumisa
analytics.of_n_tenders: kha dzithendara dza {n} dzo wanaho khumbelo
analytics.of_procurements: kha u renga ha {n} ho vulwaho
analytics.past_sla: Dzo fhira vhuimo ha tshumelo, dzi kha ḓi sa dzhiiwa tsheo
analytics.median_hint: Vhukati, uri mafhungo mathihi o imaho a sa tshinye
analytics.pipeline_hint: Hune mushumo wa xelela hone vhukati ha u dzudzanya na u vala.
analytics.plan_to_market: Mushumo wo dzudzanywaho wo swikaho makete
analytics.competition_hint: Tshifanyiso tsha dzithendara dza khumbelo nthihi ndi tsumbo yo khwaṱhaho kha ino data.
analytics.single_bid_tenders: Dzithendara dzi re na khumbelo nthihi
analytics.bottlenecks_hint: Nga gwada, ngauri khethani i a lenga arali tshidulo tshithihi khayo tshi tshi lenga.
analytics.no_decisions: A hu na tsheo dza thendelo kha ḽino ḓuvha.
analytics.deviation_turnaround: Tshifhinga tsha vhukati tsha u dzhia tsheo
analytics.no_deviations: A hu na u ṱutshela kha ḽino ḓuvha.
analytics.intake: U ṱanganedzwa ha khumbelo nga muḓagasi
analytics.awaiting_opening: Khumbelo dza {n} dzo valwaho dzi lindele u vulwa.
analytics.awards_hint: Ndi nnyi o kundaho u ṋewa ha {n}, nahone nga fhasi ha milayo ifhio.
analytics.no_awards: A hu na u ṋewa kha ḽino ḓuvha.
analytics.no_level: A hu na vhuimo ho ṅwalwaho
analytics.trend_hint: Tshoṱhe tshi amba hune na vha hone; mutevhe u amba hune na ya hone.

budgets_approvals.title: Thendelo dza mugaganyagwama
budgets_approvals.subtitle: Tsheo dzine dza ni lindela, na dzine na dzi lindela.
budgets_approvals.inbox_empty: A ku na nchumu lowu ku rindzeleke.
budgets_approvals.reject_reason_hint: Muthu loyi a swi rhumeke wa swi vona leswi, hikwalaho vula leswi faneleke ku cinca.
budgets_approvals.confirm_approve_body: Ku tendela “{label}” ku fambisa tshelede ya xiviri. Leswi swi tsariwa hi dzina ra wena.
budgets_approvals.confirm_withdraw_body: Swi huma elayinini. U nga swi lulamisa u tlhela u swi rhumela.
budgets_approvals.covering_notice: Swin'wana swa leswi swi kona hikuva u yimela thendelo ya {names}.
budgets_approvals.given_title: Ku yimeriwa loku u ku lulamiseke
budgets_approvals.given_sub: I mani loyi a khomaka thendelo ya wena ya mugaganyagwama loko u nga ri kona. Va engeteriwa tanihi vapfumeleri — u ha ta kota ku hetisisa xin'wana na xin'wana hi wexe.
budgets_approvals.received_title: Ku yimeriwa loku u ku khomaka
budgets_approvals.received_sub: Thendelo ya mani leyi u nga yi hetisisaka, na ku fikela rini.
budgets_approvals.delegate_sub: Muthu un'wana a nga hetisisa thendelo ya wena ya mugaganyagwama nkarhinyana.
budgets_approvals.delegate_notice: Ku yimeriwa ku engetela mutendeli ematshan'weni yo hundzisela mfanelo, hikwalaho u ha ta kota ku hetisisa xin'wana na xin'wana hi wexe. Ku hambanisiwa ka mintirho ka ha tirha: a ku na muthu loyi a nga tendelaka leswi u swi rhumeke.
budgets_approvals.no_delegations: A wu si lulamisa ku yimeriwa.
budgets_approvals.no_cover: A ku na muthu loyi a ku komboleke ku yimela thendelo yakwe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_end_delegation_body: {to} a nga ha koti ku hetisisa thendelo ya wena. Tsheo leswi a swi endleke a swi cinci.
budgets_approvals.delegation_open: ku suka {from}, a ku na makumu
budgets_approvals.hint_from_user: Siya swi ri wena handle ka loko u lulamisela muthu un'wana.
budgets_approvals.field_to_user: I mani loyi a nga ta yimela
budgets_approvals.hint_ends_on: Siya swi ri swa hava leswaku ku nga vi na makumu, xik. xitulu lexi nga riki na muthu.
budgets_approvals.hint_subject_limit: Siya swi ri swa hava ku yimela hinkwaswo.
budgets_approvals.hint_max_amount: Siya swi ri swa hava leswaku ku nga vi na mpimo.

budgets_approval_setup.title: Nḓila ya thendelo dza mugaganyagwama
budgets_approval_setup.subtitle: I mani a sayinaka yini, eka khampani leyi.
budgets_approval_setup.default_notice: Handle ka ndlela leyi kunguhatiweke, tsheo xin'wana na xin'wana xa mugaganyagwama xa ha yima elayinini — naswona mani na mani loyi a nga tendelaka timugaganyagwama a nga xi hetisisa. Kunguhata ndlela laha loko u lava xitlhomo xo karhi, mulayo wa masayina mambirhi, kumbe mpimo lowu ehansi ka wona ku nga rhumeriwiki nchumu.
budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: A ku na modyulu wa HR lowu nghenisiweke, hikwalaho ganḓa leri vekiweke eka “mulawuri wa murhumeri” a ri nge hetisiwi hi muthu. Shumisani vhuimo kumbe muthu la vuriweke ematshan'weni ya sweswo.
budgets_approval_setup.none_for_type: A ku na ndlela leyi kunguhatiweke — ku tirha leyi tolovelekeke.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_budget: Mugaganyagwama lowuntshwa lowu rhumeriwaka leswaku wu pfumeleriwa.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_adjustment: Ku engeteriwa, ku hunguteriwa kumbe ku hundziseriwa ka xiavelo lexi nga kona.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_override: Thendelo wo tirhisa tshelede ku tlula xiavelo.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_reservation: Tshelede leyi khomeriweke mugaganyagwama emahlweni ka loku ku va na oda ro xava.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_body: “{name}” a yi nge he rhumeli nchumu. A ku na nchumu lexi se xi hetisisiweke lexi cincaka.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_pending: “{name}” ya ha ri na tsheo swa {count} elayinini. Sweswo swi hlayisa xitlhomo na matimu ya swona; a ku na nchumu lowuntshwa lowu nga ta rhumeriwa hi yona.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_threshold: Siya swi ri swa hava leswaku ku rhumeriwa hinkwaswo.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_escalate: Swa hava swi vula leswaku u nga tsundzuxi.
budgets_approval_setup.field_type: Tshelede ya miphurojeke / yo tirha ntsena
budgets_approval_setup.hint_type: Siya swi ri swa hava eka hakumbirhi.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_category: Siya swi ri swa hava eka swiyenge hinkwaswo.
budgets_approval_setup.steps_hint: Xi tlhandlukiwa hi ku landzelelana. Vitana vhathu hi mulayo laha u nga kotaka — vhuimo xa hanya loko muthu a suka.
budgets_approval_setup.allow_self: Tendela muthu loyi a rhumeke leswaku a tendela ganḓa leri
budgets_approval_setup.approver_role: Mani na mani la nga na vhuimo
budgets_approval_setup.who_manager: Mulawuri wa murhumeri, ku suka eka HR
budgets_approval_setup.who_owner: Mani na mani la khomaka mugaganyagwama

budgets_tracking.title: U ṱoḓisisa mugaganyagwama
budgets_tracking.subtitle: Laha mugaganyagwama wun'wana na wun'wana wu yimeke kona, leswi swi vangeke tsivhudzo, na leswi swi yimisiweke.
budgets_tracking.position_hint: Leswi bohiweke swi katsa leswi vekeriweke na leswi lotleriweke, ku nga ri ntsena leswi hakeriweke hi invoyisi.
budgets_tracking.nothing_to_watch: A ku na nchumu lowu lavaka nyingiso.
budgets_tracking.no_alerts: A ku na tsivhudzo leswi tirhaka.
budgets_tracking.rules_subtitle: Loko khampani leyi yi lava ku byeriwa, na loko yi lava ku yimisiwa.
budgets_tracking.block_notice: I mulayo wa ku Sivela ntsena lowu alaka nchumu. Wu sindzisiwa laha tshelede yi vekeriwaka kumbe yi bohiwaka kona, ku nga ri ntsena eka tluka leri.
budgets_tracking.no_rules: A ku na milayo sweswi. Timugaganyagwama leti tlulaka ta ha viwa.
budgets_tracking.confirm_delete_rule_body: “{name}” wu yima ku languta. Tsivhudzo leswi wu se wu swi pfuxeke swi ta tlhantlhiwa eka ku kambela loku landzelaka.
budgets_tracking.ack_hint: Leswi endliwaka ha swona. Tsivhudzo xi tshama xi tirha ku fikela loko vhuimo xi hela.
budgets_tracking.hint_severity: Ku sivela ku ala ku vekeriwa na ku bohiwa loku ntshwa.
budgets_tracking.field_scope_value: Tshelede ya miphurojeke kumbe yo tirha
budgets_tracking.scope_expenditure_type: Tshelede ya miphurojeke kumbe yo tirha
budgets_tracking.metric_committed_pct: Leswi vekeriweke + leswi bohiweke + leswi tirhisiweke (%)

budgets_insights.analytics_sub: Ndlela tshelede yi vekiweke ha yona, laha yi yaka kona, na leswi swi rindzeleke tsheo.
budgets_insights.reports_sub: Tinhlaka leti nga endzhaku ka tichati, leti nga rhumeriwaka tanihi CSV.
budgets_insights.truncated: Ku kombisiwa tinhlaka to sungula ta 500. Ku rhumeriwa ka CSV ku na hinkwato.
budgets_insights.no_rows: A ku na nchumu laha sweswi.

report_sources.budgets: Swi tsariwa loko mugaganyagwama wu tumbuluxiwa, eka Timugaganyagwama › Mugaganyagwama Muswa.
report_sources.ledger: Swi huma eka buku ya ku vekeriwa, ku bohiwa na ku tirhisiwa ka tshelede.
report_sources.allocations: Tinhlaka to avanyisa leti tsariweke eka xiavelo xa mugaganyagwama.
report_sources.reservations: Swi tsariwa loko xikombelo xo xava xi pfumeleriwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mugaganyagwama.
report_sources.commitments: Swi tsariwa loko oda ro xava ri humesiwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mugaganyagwama.
report_sources.consumptions: Swi tsariwa loko invoyisi kumbe GRN yi tsarisiwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mugaganyagwama.
report_sources.adjustments: Swi pfuxiwa eka mugaganyagwama tanihi ku engeteriwa, ku hunguteriwa kumbe ku hundziseriwa.
report_sources.overrides: Swi pfuxiwa eka mugaganyagwama loko muthu a kombela ku tirhisa tshelede ku tlula xiavelo.
report_sources.approvals: Tsheo xin'wana na xin'wana lexi rhumeriweke, ku suka elayinini ya thendelo.
report_sources.decisions: Sayina rin'wana na rin'wana leri tsariweke eka tsheo lexi rhumeriweke.
report_sources.alerts: Swi pfuxiwa hi ku kambela ka vuḓuvha hi ku ya hi milayo ya tsivhudzo ya khampani leyi.
report_sources.phasing: Zwo dzhiiwa kha thebu ya Phasing ya mugaganyagwama muṅwe na muṅwe: zwifhinga zwo valwaho zwo fhiraho mukano wa phambano wa ṅwaha, na tshiitisi tsha uri tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsho sa swikela pulane yatsho.

chart.position_sub: Leswi vekeriweke na leswi bohiweke se swi khomiwile.
chart.bands_sub: I timugaganyagwama tingani eka xiyenge xin'wana na xin'wana.
chart.alerts_sub: Hi ntikelo, handle ka leswi tlhantlhiweke.
chart.by_type: Tshelede ya miphurojeke na tshelede yo tirha
chart.spend_title: Ku tirhisiwa ka tshelede hi nkarhi
chart.spend_sub: Hi n'hweti, na hi ku hlanganisiwa.
chart.spend_empty: A ku na tshelede leyi tsariweke sweswi. Yi ta loko invoyisi yi tsarisiwa, kumbe loko muthu a yi tsala eka mugaganyagwama.
chart.pipeline_sub: Leswi khomiweke na leswi lotleriweke emahlweni ka ku tirhisiwa ka xiviri.
chart.backlog_sub: Nkarhi lowu tsheo swi wu rindzeleke.
chart.cycle_sub: Awara ta xikarhi ku suka eku rhumeleni ku ya eka tsheo, tin'hweti ta tsevu leti hundzeke.
chart.source_title: Laha tshelede leyi tirhisiweke yi humaka kona

budgets_planning.title: U lugisela mugaganyagwama
budgets_planning.subtitle: Hundzisela ṅwaha, nghenisa rin'wana ku suka eka spredishiti, u pfala leri hetiweke.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ku averiwa hi minkarhi ku lava minkarhi; ṅwaha leri nga riki na yona a ri na pulani yo ringanisa na ku tirhisiwa ka tshelede.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: A ku na minkarhi leyi hlamuseriweke. Yi tumbuluxe eka Swipimelo leswaku timugaganyagwama ti averiwa hi minkarhi.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Migaganyagwama ya {name} ti pfariwa na rona. Ku bohiwa loku se ku endliweke ka ha lava ku hakeriwa hi invoyisi.
budgets_planning.carry_sub: Kopa timugaganyagwama ta ṅwaha u ti yisa eka leri landzelaka.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Ṅwaha leri landzelaka ri sungula hi nhlayo leyi ṅwaha leri ri nga na yona — ndhawu leyi tolovelekeke yo sungula xijikelo lexintshwa.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Ṅwaha leri landzelaka ri sungula hi leswi a swi ha kumeka. Timugaganyagwama leti nga riki na nchumu ta tlulisiwa.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Hinkwaswo swi fika tanihi swikombiso. A ku na nchumu lowu tirhaka ku fikela loko muthu a swi tendela.
budgets_planning.import_sub: CSV, yi huma hi ku kongoma eka spredishiti leyi xijikelo xi sunguleke eka yona.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Tinhlaka ti kamberiwa yin'we hi yin'we. Nhlaka yo biha yi viwa hi nomboro ya layini; leti ti lulameke ta ha nghenisiwa, tanihi swikombiso.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Fayele leyi munghenisi a yi hlayaka hi xiviri, na tinhlaka timbirhi ta xikombiso leti taleke.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Mugaganyagwama wun'wana na wun'wana eka fayele wu tumbuluxiwa eka ṅwaha leri.
budgets_planning.hint_file: CSV ntsena, ku fikela eka 5 MB. Vhulungani tanihi “CSV UTF-8” eka Excel.
budgets_planning.how_title: Ndlela ku layicha ku tirhaka ha yona
budgets_planning.how_1: Layini yo sungula yi fanele ku va ya nhloko. Madzina ma ringanisiwa handle ko languta maletere lamakulu naswona swivandla swi va ti-underscore, hikwalaho “Allocated Amount” na “allocated_amount” i khumu yin'we.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ku landzelelana ka tikhumu a ku na mhaka, naswona tikhumu leti u nga ti lavi ti nga siyiwa hi ku helela eka fayele.
budgets_planning.how_3: Nhlaka yin'wana na yin'wana yi kamberiwa yi ri yoxe. Nhlaka leyi tsandzekaka yi viwa hi nomboro ya yona eka fayele kutani yi tlulisiwa — leti salaka ta ha nghenisiwa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Hinkwaswo swi fika tanihi swikombiso. A ku na nchumu lowu tirhaka, naswona a ku na nchumu lowu nghenaka elayinini ya thendelo ku fikela loko muthu a swi rhumela.
budgets_planning.how_5: Nkoka lowu munghenisi a nga wu tiviki — xiyenge lexi tsariweke hi ndlela leyi hoxeke kumbe muxaka wa ku tirhisiwa ka tshelede — a wu endli leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka. Wu tlhelela eka leswi tolovelekeke kutani wu tsariwa tanihi tsivhudzo endzhaku.
budgets_planning.how_6: A ku na nchumu lowu susiwaka kambirhi. Ku layicha fayele yin'we kambirhi swi tumbuluxa timugaganyagwama kambirhi, hikwalaho nghenisa fayele leyi lulamisiweke eka ṅwaha lerintshwa kumbe u sungula hi ku susa swikombiso.
budgets_planning.columns_title: Leswi khumu yin'wana na yin'wana yi swi amukelaka
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Dzina ra mugaganyagwama, xik. “Vukorhokeri bya Hofisi Nkulu”. Dzina leri nga riki na nchumu ri endla leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Nomboro. Swifaniso swa tshelede, swivandla na swihambanisi swa magidi swa susiwa, hikwalaho “R 1 850 000,00” na “1850000” hakumbirhi swa tirha. Xin'wana na xin'wana lexi nga riki nomboro xi endla leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Yi tlhelela eka opex loko yi ri yoxe kumbe yi nga tiviwi.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Yi fanele ku fambisana na rin'wana ra madzina ya swiyenge lama nga ehansi. Dzina leri nga fambisaniki ri siya mugaganyagwama wu nga ri na xiyenge naswona ri pfuxa tsivhudzo.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Yi tlhelela eka ya ntolovelo loko yi ri yoxe kumbe yi nga tiviwi.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Matsalwa yo ntshunxeka lama vitanaka ndzawulo, phurojeke kumbe senthara ya tihakelo, xik. “Hofisi Nkulu”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Khodi ya maletere manharhu ku fana na ZAR. Xin'wana na xin'wana xi honisiwa kutani ku tirha leyi tolovelekeke ya khampani.
budgets_planning.col_help_description: Matsalwa yo ntshunxeka. Ma kombisiwa eka tluka ra mugaganyagwama.
budgets_planning.categories_title: Madzina ya swiyenge lawa fayele leyi yi nga ma tirhisaka
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Ku peleta ku ringanisiwa handle ko languta maletere lamakulu, kambe dzina ri fanele ku va rona hi xiviri.
budgets_planning.categories_none: A ku na swiyenge sweswi. Swi engetele ehansi ka Lulamisa › Swipimelo, kumbe u siya khumu ya xiyenge yi ri yoxe.

settings_page.subtitle: Zwine zwa nga dzheniswa hafha, vhuhulu vhungafhani, na nḓila ine maṅwalo a ṋewa madzina.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Zwi shuma kha faela iṅwe na iṅwe, hu si kha u dzhenisa hoṱhe.
settings_page.max_count_hint: Ndi dzingana dzine dza nga tsitswa nga tshifhinga tshithihi.
settings_page.types_help: Mutevhe wa thendelo. Tshithu tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi si khawo tshi hanwa.
settings_page.allowed_hint: Litshani hu si na tshithu u shumisa sethe ya tshiḽo.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Dzi bviswa kha mutevhe wo tendelwaho naho dzi hone khawo.
settings_page.show_never: Zwine zwa nga si tendelwe naho lini
settings_page.never_help: Hezwi zwi hanwa hu si na ndavha na zwo vhewaho. Buraura kana seva i nga zwi shumisa, nahone laiburari ya maṅwalo a i na tshiitisi tsha u ṱanganedza tshiṅwe.
settings_page.auto_name: Ṋeani maṅwalo madzina nga u ḓiita
settings_page.require_description: Ṱoḓani ṱhalutshedzo kha u dzhenisa huṅwe na huṅwe
settings_page.categories_hint: Zwine luṅwalo lu vha zwone, zwo fhambana na hune lwo dzheniswa. Zwipiḓa zwo fhaṱwaho zwi nga ṋewa madzina maṅwe kana zwi valwa fhedzi a zwi bviswi — mivhigo na milayo ya u vhulunga zwi sumbedza khazwo.
settings_page.category_order_hint: Tshi re fhasi tshi bvelela u thoma
settings_page.category_protected: Zwipiḓa zwo fhaṱwaho a zwi nga si bviswe. Ṱhanzi ya zwenezwo tshi valeni.
settings_page.category_in_use: Tshi shumiswa nga maṅwalo a {n}. Ṱhanzi ya zwenezwo tshi valeni.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Sevhani vhathu luṅwalo lu sa athu fhela. U kunya hu shuma matsheloni oṱhe nahone hu rumela tshihumbudzo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe luthihi.
settings_page.expiry_days: Sevhani maḓuvha manzhi nga u ralo hu tshi kha ḓi vha na tshifhinga
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Puṱedzani enter nga murahu ha tshivhalo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. 0 zwi amba nga ḓuvha ḽa u fhela ḽine.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Muṋe wa luṅwalo u ḓivhadzwa tshifhinga tshoṱhe. Mishumo, hu si madzina, uri tshihumbudzo tshi tevhele naho ndi nnyi o fara mushumo.
settings_page.retention_hint: How long documents in this category are kept. Leave the period empty for no schedule — nothing is ever destroyed automatically.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Shown beside the disposal queue, so a reviewer can see what the rule is for.
settings_page.sharing_warning: With this on, anybody holding a share link can open that document without signing in. Each link still expires, can be revoked, and is recorded.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Allow documents to be shared outside the organisation
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: The ceiling for any link. Somebody asking for longer gets this.
settings_page.ai_warning: With this on, the contents of a document are sent to the AI provider this platform is configured with, and count against the company’s monthly allowance.
settings_page.ai_enabled: Allow summaries and questions about documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential: Include confidential and legally held documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Off by default. These are the documents an organisation is least willing to hand to an outside service.
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Each share can still be changed individually. A watermark makes a leaked copy traceable; it does not prevent one.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: With this on, documents a reviewer has approved for disposal are deleted without further confirmation. Deletion here is recoverable — permanent destruction always stays with a person.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: How long an approval waits before it is acted on, so a mistake can be caught.
settings_page.automation_hint: What this category does on its own once the dates above have passed.
settings_page.archive_after_years_hint: Counted from the same date as the retention period
settings_page.auto_delete: Delete automatically once a disposal is approved
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Needs the company-wide setting as well. Documents under legal hold are never touched.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Zwine lushaka ulu lwa ḽiṅwalo lwa zwi hwala nṱhani ha zwo ḓoweleaho. Thendelano i ṱoḓa muṅwe muhwalo; risiti a i ṱoḓi tshithu.
settings_page.category_workflow_default: Maitele a lushaka ulu lwa ḽiṅwalo
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Uri "mbekanyamaitele dzi ya kha mulayo" hu vhe tshithu tsha mbekanyamaitele nṱhani ha u humbulwa kha u dzhenisa huṅwe na huṅwe.
settings_page.category_workflow_required: A i nga vhulungwi i si na yone
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: I vhewe u bvela phanḓa u bva kha spreadsheet nṱhani ha u thoma hafhu kha 1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Vhupo: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} na #### kha u tevhekana. I siyeni i si na tshithu u shumisa dzinomboro dza khamphani.
settings_page.watermark_confidential: Tshifhinga tshoṱhe swayani maṅwalo a tshiphiri
settings_page.watermark_previews: Swayani zwisumbedzo nga dzina ḽa muvhali
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: U vhala fhedzi hu thivhela u dzhenisa fhedzi a hu iti tshithu nga tshifanyiso tsha tshikirini. Tshiswayo tshine tsha amba uri ndi nnyi o vha a tshi sedza ndi tshone fhedzi tshine tsha ita nga u ralo.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Tshifhinga tshine muthu a vhulunga khopi yo tendelwaho.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Nga murahu ha hezwi ḽiṅwalo ḽi a ḓivula, uri hu si vhe na o thivhelwaho nga o awelaho.

document_management.holds_subtitle: What is being preserved, and for which matter
document_management.holds_pick_matter: Choose a matter to see what is held under it.
document_management.holds_release_warning: Once the last hold is lifted, this document can be deleted and destroyed again. The record that it was held is kept.
document_management.holds_close_matter_warning: This lifts every hold placed under {reference} — {n} document(s) at once.
document_management.disposal_subtitle: Documents whose retention period has run out
document_management.disposal_nothing_automatic: Nothing here is destroyed automatically. Each document waits for somebody to decide, and approving a disposal is not the same as carrying it out.
document_management.disposal_keep_explained: It stays, and comes up for review again at the end of its next retention period.
document_management.disposal_approve_explained: This records that it may be destroyed. Somebody with the destroy permission still has to carry it out.
document_management.disposal_note_hint: Why this was decided. It is kept with the document’s history.
document_management.disposal_queue_empty: Nothing has come due for review.
document_management.sharing_off: External sharing is switched off for this company.
document_management.share_none: This document has not been shared outside.
document_management.share_link_once: Copy this link now — it is not shown again.
document_management.share_warning: Anyone holding this link can open the document without signing in.
document_management.share_recipient_hint: Not a restriction — it records who it was meant for.
document_management.share_password_hint: Optional. Send it separately from the link.
document_management.share_allow_download_hint: Off means the document can be read but not saved.
document_management.shared_locked_hint: Enter the password you were given to open it.
document_management.ai_summary_caveat: Written by a model from the document’s text. Check anything you intend to act on against the document itself.
document_management.ai_question_hint: Answered only from this document’s text.
document_management.ai_unavailable: The assistant is not available for this document.
document_management.ai_disabled: The assistant is switched off for this company.
document_management.ai_confidential_excluded: This document is confidential or under legal hold, and this company has not allowed those to be sent to the assistant.
document_management.ai_no_text: There is no readable text in this document — it may be a scan that needs OCR.
document_management.ai_quota: This company’s monthly AI allowance is used up.
document_management.ai_failed: The assistant could not be reached. Try again shortly.
document_management.share_internal_none: Not shared with anybody beyond the usual folder access.
document_management.share_internal_hint: This opens the document to somebody who cannot otherwise see it. It does not change who can see anything else.
document_management.share_internal_expiry_hint: Leave empty to keep it open
document_management.activity_subtitle: Every recorded action on documents you can see
document_management.activity_recent: The last {days} days. Use the dates to look further back.
document_management.activity_document_gone: a document that has since been removed

document_management.access_requests_subtitle: People asking to be let in to a document or folder
document_management.access_folder_note: This grants the documents filed in that folder now. Anything added later is a new decision.

document_management.perm_manage_explainer: Somebody who administers a folder decides who else may use it. They cannot move it, delete it, or reach any other folder.
document_management.folder_permissions_subtitle: A group survives somebody joining or leaving. A list of names has to be revisited every time either happens.
document_management.folder_permissions_none: Nobody has been given this folder. Whether it is open depends on the folder's own kind.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_body: This replaces every rule on {name} with what is on screen.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_consequence: Anybody whose row you removed loses access as soon as this is saved.
document_management.groups_delete_consequence: Everyone in it loses every folder the group opened. The folders and their documents are untouched.
document_management.groups_remove_member_title: Take this person out of the group?
document_management.groups_remove_member_consequence: They lose every folder this group opens, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_title: Take this folder off the group?
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_consequence: Everyone in the group loses it, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.documents_delete_consequence: It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored until the bin is emptied.
document_management.templates_delete_consequence: Documents already generated from it are not affected.
document_management.quotas_remove_consequence: Storage there becomes unlimited again, up to the company's own allowance.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_body: {who} would no longer see this document.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_consequence: Unless they can reach it another way — through a folder, a role or a group.

document_management.access_map_revoke_body: {who} would lose it now rather than when it was due to end.
document_management.access_map_revoke_consequence: It cannot be undone from here — it would have to be granted again.

employee_reputation_dashboard.title: U Lavhelesa Bvumo na Khombo ya Mushumi
employee_reputation_dashboard.subtitle: U lavhelesa ho tendelwaho ha mafhungo a TSHITSHAVHA kha mafhungo, khothe, mulanguli, ndaṱiso, matshilisano na zwisima zwa vhutsila — u itela u sedzwa nga muthu.
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_title: Ṱhoḓisiso ya muthu — a hu na tsheo dzi ḓiitaho
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_body: Modulo iyi i bveledza mafhungo a TSHITSHAVHA ane a nga vha a ndeme zwoṱhe na mutheo, u fulufhela na hune a bva hone u itela musedzi wa muthu. A i iti kana u themendela mvelelo dza u thola, u pandela kana dza vhuḓifhinduleli. U fana ha dzina a si khwaṱhisedzo ya vhuṋe. Shumisani fhedzi nga thendelo na u tevhedza mulayo wa tshiphiri na wa vhashumi.
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain: Zwo wanalaho nga fhethu ha tsumbo
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain_hint: Zwisumbo zwa tshitshavha zwo ṱanganyiwa nga fhethu. Fhethu hu livhaho kha khombo ndi ha ṱhoḓisiso fhedzi, hu si tsheo.
employee_reputation_dashboard.domain_risk: Zwi livhaho kha khombo — u itela ṱhoḓisiso
employee_reputation_dashboard.domain_positive: Mutheo wavhuḓi / u sa dzhii sia
employee_reputation_dashboard.no_alerts: A hu na ndivhadzo dzo vulwaho.
employee_reputation_dashboard.no_scans: A hu na zwiskeno zwo itwaho.

employee_reputation_settings.title: Nzudzanyo dza u lavhelesa bvumo na khombo
employee_reputation_settings.subtitle: Nzudzanyani u lavhelesa ho tendelwaho hu shumisaho mafhungo a tshitshavha fhedzi. Zwoṱhe zwo wanalaho zwi bveledzwa u itela u sedzwa nga muthu.
employee_reputation_settings.enabled: Vulani u lavhelesa bvumo na khombo
employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Vulani u lavhelesa fhedzi hune na tendelwa hone na hune zwa tendelana na mulayo wa tshiphiri na wa vhashumi. Hu lavhelesiwa mafhungo a TSHITSHAVHA fhedzi — hu si dziakhaunthe dza tshiphiri. Zwo wanalaho zwi a ṱalutshedzea, zwi na u fulufhela na hune zwa bva hone, zwi ṱhonifha tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga tshi re fhasi, zwi langulwa nga u swikelela nahone zwi sedzwa nga vhuḓalo, nahone a zwi vhuyi zwa shumiselwa tsheo dza mushumo dzi ḓiitaho.
employee_reputation_settings.consent_required: Ṱoḓani thendelo / thendelo ya mushumi hu sa athu lavheleswa
employee_reputation_settings.consent_hint: Hu lavhelesiwa mafhungo a tshitshavha fhedzi — hu si dziakhaunthe dza tshiphiri. Ṱhoḓisiso ya muthu i a ṱoḓea hu sa athu vha na nyito.
employee_reputation_settings.score_drop: Ḓivhadzani musi zwipiḓa zwi tshi fhungudzea nga
employee_reputation_settings.negative_spike: Ḓivhadzani nga muhumbulo muvhi kha kana fhasi ha
employee_reputation_settings.auto_reports: Bveledzani nga u ḓiita mivhigo ya ṱhoḓisiso ya AI (u itela u sedzwa nga muthu) kha ndivhadzo khulwane

recruitment_screening_show.title: U sedzwa ha vhahumbeli nga AI
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_title: U itela u sedzwa nga muthu — a si tsheo ya u thola i ḓiitaho
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_body: Hedzi tsumbo dzo bveledzwaho nga AI ndi thuso ya tsheo fhedzi nahone a dzo ngo fanela u fhaṱutshedza u thola kana u hana hu ḓiitaho. U fana ha dzina a si khwaṱhisedzo ya vhuṋe. Sedzani vhuṱanzi nga inwi vhaṋe nahone ni ṋee muhumbeli tshibuli tsha u ṋetshedza mutheo ni sa athu ita tsheo.
recruitment_screening_show.confirm_rescreen: Shumani u sedzwa ha AI ha uyu muhumbeli hafhu? Hezwi zwi sengulusa u vha hone havho ha vhutsila ha tshitshavha u itela u sedzwa nga muthu fhedzi.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_title: A hu na u sedzwa ho itwaho
recruitment_screening_show.empty_body: A hu na u sedzwa ha AI ho itwaho ha uyu muhumbeli. Shumani huṅwe u bveledza tsumbo dza vhutsila dza tshitshavha u itela u sedzwa.
